title: Egyptian Chicken Kebabs
description: A flavorful and spicy chicken dish inspired by Egyptian street food, perfect for grilling during the summer. This recipe combines juicy chicken, aromatic spices, and a hint of citrus.
instructions: 1. In a large bowl, whisk together kebab spice mix, lemon juice, and olive oil.
2. Add the chicken to the bowl and mix until coated with the marinade.
3. Cover the bowl with plastic wrap and refrigerate for at least 2 hours or overnight.
4. Preheat the grill to medium-high heat.
5. Remove the chicken from the marinade, letting any excess liquid drip off.
6. Thread the chicken, onion, bell pepper, and tomato onto skewers.
7. Season with salt and black pepper to taste.
8. Grill the kebabs for 8-10 minutes per side, or until the chicken is cooked through.
9. Serve the kebabs hot with pita bread and your favorite sides.
10. Garnish with parsley or cilantro, if desired.
